meta.title: 演讲开场如何抓住听众的注意力?
meta.title_en: How to Grab Your Audience in the First 10 Seconds
meta.topic: 演讲技巧 · 开场抓注意力

scenes.title_cn: 大多数演讲者10秒内失去听众
scenes.title_en: Most Speakers Lose the Audience in 10 Seconds
scenes.context: 演讲开始：听众注意力集中。但介绍完名字和标题，听众就流失了。大多数演讲者在开场10秒内失去听众，因为他们讲得太安全——从名字、头衔和无聊的背景开始。语域：英文演讲教学，痛点引入。
sentences: Most presenters lose their audience in the first 10 seconds.
大多数演讲者在开场10秒内失去听众。
paraphrase: play it safe → 求稳/保守开场
didn't see coming → 没想到 / 出乎意料
scenes.speak: Most presenters lose their audience in the first 10 seconds. Because they play it safe. Say something they didn't expect — something they didn't see coming.

scenes.title_en: Technique One: Surprising Statement Plus a Pause
scenes.context: 第一个技巧：惊人陈述。平均每个人睡觉时会吃约70只昆虫——这个数字很震撼，但大多数人只是一带而过，听众还没消化就进入下一点。正确做法：说出数字，停顿两秒，再带着数字完整说一遍那句话。语域：英文演讲教学，技巧讲解。
sentences: The average person will eat around 70 insects while sleeping.
平均每个人睡觉时会吃约70只昆虫。
Say the number, then stop talking for two seconds.
That pause helps the audience really process it.
那个停顿让听众真正消化它。
paraphrase: surprising statement → 惊人陈述 / 反常识开场
rush through → 一带而过 / 匆匆讲完
scenes.speak: The average person will eat around 70 insects while sleeping. Say the number, then stop talking for two seconds. That pause helps the audience really process it.

scenes.title_en: Technique Two: A Show of Hands
scenes.context: 第二个技巧：举手示意。谁喜欢披萨上放菠萝？谁觉得这是反人类？谁完全不知道我在说什么？举手问题很常见，但关键是让观众参与互动。语域：英文演讲教学，技巧讲解。
sentences: Show of hands: who here likes pineapple on pizza?
举手示意：谁喜欢披萨上放菠萝？
Who thinks it's a crime against humanity?
谁觉得这是反人类的行为？
Show-of-hands questions get the audience involved.
举手问题让听众参与进来。
paraphrase: show of hands → 举手示意 / 互动提问
no clue → 完全不知道 / 一脸懵
scenes.speak: Show of hands: who here likes pineapple on pizza? Who thinks it's a crime against humanity? Show-of-hands questions get the audience involved.

scenes.context: 第三个技巧：用问题引出内容。好的开场像钩子，用问题、数字或反常识信息把听众勾住，再展开演讲。语域：英文演讲教学，收尾。
sentences: Start with a question that pulls them in.
用一个问题把听众拉进来。
A hook makes the speech memorable.
好的钩子让演讲令人难忘。
paraphrase: hook → 钩子 / 开场吸引点
like a pro → 像专业人士 / 行家水准
scenes.speak: Start with a question that pulls them in. A hook makes the speech memorable. Start like a pro.

practice: Most presenters lose their audience in the first 10 seconds.
Say the number, then stop talking for two seconds.
Show of hands: who here likes pineapple on pizza?
Start with a question that pulls them in.
pitfalls: Most speakers fail in the first minute.
Most presenters lose their audience in the first 10 seconds.
「失去听众」用 lose their audience，不是 fail。
Say the number, then stop talking for two seconds.
要停顿（stop talking），不是快速带过。
Show of hands: who here likes pineapple on pizza?
shifts: 用 lose their audience（失去听众）、play it safe（求稳）、didn't see coming（出乎意料）
用 surprising statement（惊人陈述）、a show of hands（举手示意）、a hook（钩子）
用 pause（停顿）、process it（消化）、get involved（参与）、like a pro（专业水准）
